第三章 你这样叫我更喜欢（第1页）
距离那次梦境构筑已过去七天，月翎没再见过风奕。
课堂上，导师讲述的精神力滋养法门，在她耳中只是无意义的嗡鸣。
她的精神力太过低微，这些对她统统没用。
下课铃响起，她随着同学们一起往外走，旁边传来了雌性兴奋的声音，“风奕学长回来了？”
“对，我刚看到风奕学长往实验楼那边去了……”
月翎脚步一顿，立马朝着和宿舍相反的实验楼方向而去。
实验楼侧面僻静的回廊里，月翎安静地站在雕花廊柱后耐心等待。
不知道过了多久，风奕的身影出现在视野里。
那一夜后，她相信风奕已经对她的信息素非常熟悉。
只要她调动精神力释放一丝，他一定会捕捉到，主动来找她。
熟悉的声音陡然从侧后方传来，一只手臂撑在她面前的柱子上，挡住了她的去路。
卡隆，帝国三流家族的次子，一向把雌性当做玩物。
他居高临下地看着她，目光黏腻地扫过她精致白皙的脸庞，“考虑好了吗？月翎，跟着我，我不会亏待你的……”
眼角余光里，风奕的身影即将拐弯离开。
她声音陡然拔高，在安静的走廊里显得格外突兀，“你别过来！”
她试图向后躲，背脊紧紧抵住廊柱，将作为猎物的脆弱表演得淋漓尽致。
他非但没退，反而更兴奋地逼近，就在他手指即将碰到她的刹那，

一记干脆利落的耳光，狠狠扇在他脸上。
卡隆被打得偏过头，愣了一下，随即暴怒：“你敢打我？”
他彻底失去耐心，一把攥住月翎纤细的手腕，蛮力将她往更昏暗的角落拖拽。
月翎用力挣扎，呼救声带着哭腔，足够传到不远处的雄性耳里。
卡隆被她挣扎的样子激得越发上头，喘着粗气道：“你这样子叫，我更喜欢了！”
话音未落，一道挺拔高大的身影截断了卡隆的去路。
风奕的声音没什么起伏，压迫感却像抵在喉头的锋刃。
卡隆看到他，脸上的怒意瞬间被惊惧取代。
他认得这张脸，更认得这张脸背后代表的绝对权势。
卡隆迅速松开手，挤出尴尬的笑，“误会，都是误会！
我和月翎学妹……开个玩笑，闹着玩呢……”
为一个只有姿色的底层雌性得罪风奕，除非他疯了。
在风奕那双冰珀色眼眸的注视下，他边说边后退，“我想起还有些事，先走一步。”
月翎低着头，肩膀微微颤抖，仿佛惊魂未定。
她小声说着，转身欲走，脚步虚浮，将一个受惊后急于逃离现场的雌性扮演得无可挑剔。
就在她转身的刹那，风奕的身体先于大脑做出了反应。
他猛地伸出手，一把攥住了她的手腕！
地回头，泛着水雾的眼眶里透露出警惕，“学长，怎么了？”
他握着她手腕，指尖传来雌性皮肤细腻的触感。
他却没有向往常一样厌烦，而是翕动鼻翼，试图捕捉刚刚那一闪而逝的熟悉气息。

雌性身上传来柔和的馨香，和那晚将他拖入旖旎深渊的极致幽香有一分相似。
却也仅仅相似，完全没有直击他精神海、令人他颤栗沉溺的魔力。
风奕的眉头锁得更深，眼底翻涌着烦躁。
风奕回神，迅速松开了握住她的手。
月翎惊魂未定，怯怯地冲他点了点头，迅速转身离开。
转过身的月翎脸上哪里还有眼泪和惊惶？
她眸中怯懦褪尽，脸颊挂着一抹浅浅的笑意，一步一步缓缓消失在风奕的视线里。

Chapter 3 I like it better if you call me this way (Page 1)
Seven days have passed since that dream construction, and Yue Ling has not seen Feng Yi again.
In class, the spiritual nourishment methods described by the instructor were just meaningless buzzing in her ears.
Her mental strength is too low, these are of no use to her.
When the bell rang, she walked out with her classmates. An excited female voice came from beside her, "Senior Feng Yi is back?"
"Yes, I just saw Senior Feng Yi going to the laboratory building..."
Yue Ling paused and immediately headed towards the experimental building opposite to the dormitory.
In the secluded corridor on the side of the laboratory building, Yue Ling stood quietly behind the carved pillars and waited patiently.
I don’t know how long it took, but Feng Yi’s figure appeared in the field of vision.
After that night, she believed that Feng Yi was already very familiar with her pheromones.
As long as she mobilizes her mental power to release a little bit, he will definitely catch it and come to her.
A familiar voice suddenly came from the side and behind, and an arm was placed on the pillar in front of her, blocking her way.
Caron, the second son of a third-rate family in the empire, has always regarded females as playthings.
He looked at her condescendingly, his eyes scanning her delicate and fair face with sticky eyes, "Have you considered it? Yue Ling, follow me, I won't treat you badly..."
In the corner of his eye, Feng Yi's figure was about to turn away.
Her voice suddenly rose, which seemed particularly abrupt in the quiet corridor, "Don't come over here!"
She tried to hide backwards, pressing her back tightly against the pillar, showing off her fragility as a prey to the fullest.
Instead of retreating, he approached even more excitedly. Just when his fingers were about to touch her,
A sharp slap across his face.
Caron was hit to the side of his head, stunned for a moment, and then became furious: "You dare to hit me?"
He completely lost his patience, grabbed Yue Ling's slender wrist, and dragged her to a darker corner with brute force.
Yue Ling struggled hard, and her cry for help was loud enough to reach the ears of the male not far away.
Caron was aroused even more by her struggling, and gasped: "I like it even more when you scream like this!"
Before he finished speaking, a tall and tall figure cut off Caron's path.
Feng Yi's voice had no ups and downs, but the pressure felt like a sharp edge against his throat.
When Caron saw him, the anger on his face was instantly replaced by fear.
He recognized this face, and even more so, he recognized the absolute power behind this face.
Caron quickly let go of his hand and forced out an awkward smile, "Misunderstanding, it's all a misunderstanding!
Senior Yue Ling and I...were just joking, joking..."
To offend Feng Yi for a low-level female who only has beauty, unless he is crazy.
Under the gaze of Feng Yi's icy amber eyes, he backed away as he spoke, "I remembered that I have something else to do, so I'll take the first step."
Yue Ling lowered her head and her shoulders trembled slightly, as if she was in shock.
She whispered, turned to leave, her steps were frivolous, and she played the role of a frightened female eager to flee the scene impeccably.
The moment she turned around, Feng Yi's body reacted before her brain.
He suddenly reached out his hand and grabbed her wrist!
He turned around, his misty eyes showing vigilance, "Senior, what's wrong?"
He held her wrist, and the delicate touch of female skin came from his fingertips.
However, he was not as bored as usual. Instead, he wiggled his nose, trying to catch the fleeting familiar scent just now.
The soft fragrance coming from the female's body was somewhat similar to the ultimate fragrance that dragged him into the charming abyss that night.
But it was only similar, and there was no magic power that directly hit his spiritual sea and made him tremble and indulge.
Feng YiHis brows furrowed deeper, and annoyance surged in his eyes.
Feng Yi came to his senses and quickly released his hold on her hand.
Yue Ling was still in shock, nodded timidly to him, and quickly turned around and left.
Where are the tears and panic on Yueling's face when she turned around?
The timidity in her eyes faded away, a faint smile hung on her cheeks, and she slowly disappeared from Feng Yi's sight step by step.
